description: Paycheck take-home calculator — US take-home pay estimate for 2026: federal income tax (2026 brackets + standard deduction), Social Security (wage base $184,500), Medicare incl. 0.9% additional, optional flat state rate, 401k and section-125 pre-tax deductions, child tax credit. Give salary= (annual) or gross= (per paycheck) or hourly= (+ hours= per week). Optional: frequency=weekly|biweekly|semimonthly|monthly|quarterly|annual (default biweekly), status=single|married|hoh, pretax_401k=, pretax_health= (per paycheck $), dependents= (under 17), state_rate= (percent). Returns per-paycheck and annual breakdown, marginal/effective rates, take-home percent. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
